title: Email Validator
prompt: Write a Python function named `validate_email(email: str) -> bool` that returns True if the string is a valid email (contains exactly one '@', non-empty username, and a domain with at least one dot), otherwise False.
test_suite:
assert validate_email('user@example.com') is True
assert validate_email('invalid-email') is False
assert validate_email('@domain.com') is False
assert validate_email('user@domain') is False
assert validate_email('') is False
